title: laundry sorter
text: laundry sorter. Took husband about 30 minutes to complete construction.  It arrives in about as many pieces as you can imagine.  Lightweight frame with stiffer canvas bags.  The hooks are rubberized so they sort of stay in place... you can slide them a little.  I think it is designed in a way that you can pick the bags off the frame and dump into the washer.  I choose to pick the clothes out of the bag and to into the washer.  To each her own.  There are wheels which are convenient.. 2 regular and 2 locking.  I chose the "gray."  The bags are a medium gray and the aluminum frame is gray.  There are three bags in the size I chose.  I believe there is also a 4 bag option.  Time will tell how this holds up, and I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Simple Houseware Heavy Duty 3-Bag Laundry Sorter Rolling Cart, Bronze
features: STURDY FRAME: Durable Silver finish steel with an EXTRA horizontal behind bar (which counts six horizontal bars in total) making it a solid frame
DURABLE BAGS: Each heavy duty Grey bag holds 13 Gallons of clothes, easy to clean
HEAVY DUTY CASTERS: Two of the casters come with brakes, takes on heavy loadstand rolls smoothly
Bag Dimension: 8.5'' D x 15.5'' W x 23'' H; Frame Dimension: 17.5 '' D x 30.5'' W x 33'' H (height includes casters)
